reference_kind_values: Predeclared semantic rubric, not a source-authored assistant answer
modification_notice: Selected original WAVs from official speaker archives; removed transcript inter-character spaces; project-authored response policy and semantic rubrics added; no synthetic audio or source transcript corrections

scoring_policy.instruction_and_content: Respond directly to question or necessary clarification, no invented user facts or physical experience, Traditional Chinese, one to three sentences. Each requirement is checked separately before any combined pass.
scoring_policy.typed_vs_spoken: Use same system/history with gold character-spaceless source question vs actual ASR prediction; do not insert gold text into spoken route.
scoring_policy.ASR_raw_CER_reference: Original source character string with only annotation-separating whitespace removed; corpus has no punctuation, original Simplified script retained
scoring_policy.ASR_normalized_CER: NFKC and all-whitespace removal, punctuation and original script retained; script-equivalence diagnostic reported separately if used
scoring_policy.EOS: Stopping criterion is independent of response adequacy
scoring_policy.scope: Small sample of human read questions only; not free speech-chat success rate or unseen foundation-pretraining-data claim

supports: 可直接確定評分判準由本專案提供而非 AISHELL 來源附帶；目前讀到的程式與資料紀錄不標明編寫者是 AI 或真人，也未記錄逐題真人審核的狀態。
limits: 找不到上述來源欄位不等於已證明 AI 撰寫，亦不等於已證明從未有人逐題審核；需作者原始來源紀錄或對應流程收據。
